title: India-Maldives Real-Time Payment Corridor Goes Live via Favara and UPI Integration
summary: Expands India's digital public infrastructure internationally, reducing cross-border remittance costs.

blocks.content: Expands India's digital public infrastructure internationally, reducing cross-border remittance costs.

items: Maldives integrated instant payment system **'Favara'** with India's **Unified Payments Interface (UPI)**.
Transfer Flow: Transferred in **Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR)** and credited directly in **Indian Rupees (₹/INR)** to UPI bank accounts.
Implementation: Partnership between **Maldives Monetary Authority (MMA)**, **RBI**, and **NIPL**.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: NIPL established April 2020 as international subsidiary of NPCI | Maldives Currency: Maldivian Rufiyaa | Capital: Malé.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Maldives' instant payment system Favara vs Singapore's PayNow vs UAE's AANI/Jaywan vs Sri Lanka's LankaPay.

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "What strategic advantages does NIPL achieve by linking UPI with systems like Favara?"
💡 **Model Answer: Slashes cross-border remittance costs while promoting INR settlements across South Asia.**
blocks.author: Banking & Regulatory Board Panel
